examples.title: Isavuconazole for the Prevention of COVID-19-associated Pulmonary Aspergillosis

summary: According to the official drug label, severe liver problems and reactions linked to intravenous infusions have been reported with this medication [3]. Liver tests are evaluated at the beginning and during therapy [3]. Additionally, a small computer model, rather than tests in people, estimated a high score for liver issues and a low score for heart issues [M].
